Art style: chunky toy-like nautical world in glossy painted enamel and varnished timber, bold readable silhouettes, soft bevelled edges, saturated signal colours (signal red, sunflower yellow, cobalt blue, enamel white, varnished teak, brass), like a premium hand-painted toy regatta caught in a storm. A saturated stylised sea of deep teal to emerald with cream-white foam crests and spray, never grey. Chunky toy-proportioned captains with big heads, oversized hands and boots, and big hats. Keep the main subject composed in the CENTRE THIRD of the frame. Scene: golden afternoon regatta. Chase camera low over the foredeck of the player's glossy red sloop: in the lower centre third the player captain seen from behind (red oilskin coat, yellow sou'wester hat) holding an upright red-and-white striped jousting lance with a round brass hand guard. Ahead in the centre, a glossy sunflower-yellow rival yacht charges head-on through rolling golden-lit swell, its captain with a lowered lance, bow throwing cream spray. Low gold sun breaking under bruised violet storm cloud, warm gold light against violet shadow. Spectator motorboats and colourful triangle bunting flags (plain, no symbols) at the sides, a red and white lighthouse on a rock in the distance.
